title: Tiny, cute present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e0345c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff90a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f05070'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x='24' y='44' width='52' height='40' rx='6' fill='url(#boxGrad)'/>
  <!-- box body top highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='44' width='52' height='7' rx='4' fill='#ffa3b6'/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon on body -->
  <rect x='44' y='44' width='12' height='40' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='3' height='40' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <rect x='18' y='34' width='64' height='14' rx='5' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='34' width='64' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ffb3c4'/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='14' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='46' y='34' width='3' height='14' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <!-- bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='26' rx='13' ry='9' transform='rotate(-18 38 26)' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='26' rx='8' ry='5' transform='rotate(-18 38 26)' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='13' ry='9' transform='rotate(18 62 26)' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='8' ry='5' transform='rotate(18 62 26)' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- bow knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffbe0b'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='28' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- heart on lid -->
  <path d='M50 46 l-1.5 -2.5 a2 2 0 1 1 3 0 z' fill='#fff4b0' transform='translate(0 -1)'/>
</svg>
